nodes.label: Sam
nodes.desc: Composes ImageEncoderViT, PromptEncoder, and MaskDecoder; forward runs the full image+prompt to mask pass.

nodes.label: ImageEncoderViT
nodes.desc: ViT backbone with 16x16 patches, interleaved windowed/global attention, and a conv neck to 256 channels.

nodes.label: PatchEmbed
nodes.desc: Projects the image with a strided Conv2d and adds sinusoidal absolute position embeddings.

nodes.label: Block
nodes.desc: Attention+MLP block; uses windowed attention except at global_attn_indexes layers.

nodes.label: Attention
nodes.desc: Multi-head attention with optional rel-pos decomposition of q and k per head.

nodes.label: window_partition
nodes.desc: Reshapes HxW feature maps into non-overlapping window_size x window_size batches for cheap attention.

nodes.label: LayerNorm2d
nodes.desc: Channel-last-style 2D layer norm used inside the encoder neck and the decoder upscaling stack.

nodes.label: MLPBlock
nodes.desc: Standard GELU MLP used in every encoder transformer block.

nodes.label: PromptEncoder
nodes.desc: Turns points, boxes, and masks into sparse tokens and a dense embedding map aligned with the image grid.

nodes.label: _embed_points
nodes.desc: Embeds click coordinates with learned pos/neg weights plus a pad token for boxes.

nodes.label: _embed_boxes
nodes.desc: Represents a box as its two corner points with a shared corner embedding.

nodes.label: _embed_masks
nodes.desc: Downsamples a low-res mask prompt with convs into the dense embedding space.

nodes.label: get_dense_pe
nodes.desc: Sinusoidal positional encoding added to dense mask-prompt embeddings.

nodes.label: MaskDecoder
nodes.desc: predict_masks runs the two-way transformer, then hypernetwork MLPs and upscaling produce 3 mask types.

nodes.label: predict_masks
nodes.desc: Concatenates IoU + mask tokens with image and sparse prompt tokens and runs the two-way transformer.

nodes.label: output_upscaling
nodes.desc: Two-stage transposed conv stack that upscales the 64x64 embedding 4x for mask matmul.

nodes.label: iou_token
nodes.desc: Learned token whose output feeds the IoU quality head.

nodes.label: mask_tokens
nodes.desc: Four learned tokens: one whole/part/subpart triplet style plus one scratch slot at inference.

nodes.label: output_hypernetworks_mlps
nodes.desc: One MLP per mask token producing dynamic 32x32 kernel weights.

nodes.label: iou_prediction_head
nodes.desc: Small MLP predicting mask quality so callers can pick the best candidate without labels.

nodes.label: MLP
nodes.desc: Generic GELU MLP reused for hypernetworks and the IoU head.

nodes.label: TwoWayTransformer
nodes.desc: Two-layer bidirectional transformer: image-to-prompt then prompt-to-image attention per layer.

nodes.label: TwoWayAttentionBlock
nodes.desc: Four steps: self-attention on image, image-to-prompt, MLP, then prompt-to-image attention.

nodes.label: Attention
nodes.desc: Decoder-side multi-head attention with optional downsample rate and separate q/k/v projections.

nodes.label: SamPredictor
nodes.desc: Holds precomputed image embeddings so repeated prompts skip the expensive encoder.

nodes.label: set_image
nodes.desc: Resizes to 1024 on the long side, normalizes, runs the encoder once, and caches the embedding.

nodes.label: predict_torch
nodes.desc: Batched prompt decoding: embeds prompts, runs the mask decoder, optionally masks padded regions.

nodes.label: SamAutomaticMaskGenerator
nodes.desc: Configure-it-yourself whole-image mask generation with crops, stability scoring, and dedup.

nodes.label: generate
nodes.desc: Splits the image into crops, runs per-crop point grids, then post-processes small regions.

nodes.label: _process_crop
nodes.desc: Builds a points_per_side grid of prompts, batches predictions, and uncrops masks back to full image.

nodes.label: MaskData
nodes.desc: Dict-like carrier for masks/boxes/scores with filtering and cropping utilities shared by AMG.

nodes.label: sam_model_registry
nodes.desc: Maps 'default'/vit_b/vit_l/vit_h to builder functions with the right ViT hyperparameters.

nodes.label: _build_sam
nodes.desc: Instantiates the three submodules from HyperParameters, loads the state dict, and switches to eval.

nodes.label: SamOnnxModel
nodes.desc: Decoder-only ONNX wrapper so the heavy ViT stays in Python while prompts run in a browser.
